library.name: opus-encdec
library.description: JavaScript wrapper that encodes and decodes Opus. The asm.js files in js/ come from this package.

library.name: libopus
library.description: Opus audio codec compiled into the opus-encdec asm.js files shipped in js/.

library.name: speexdsp
library.description: SpeexDSP resampler compiled into the opus-encdec asm.js files shipped in js/. The live room uses matching 48 kHz rates, so this resampler is not started.

library.name: @fastpubsub-sdk/client
library.description: FastPubSub browser client bundled into the live room script.
